text: This staff report is in regards to a matter for which the North York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to consider an application submitted by the owner of 74 Clansman Boulevard to maintain an existing 2.8 meter high vertical board on board fence in the side and rear yard. The existing vertical board on board fence does not meet the requirements specified in City of Toronto Municipal Code, Chapter 447, Fences.

North York Community Council: 1. Granted the exemption to the owners of 74 Clansman Boulevard to allow a 2.8 metre high existing vertical board on board fence in the side and rear yard, to be maintained in the same condition, without alteration. 2. Directed that, at such time as replacement of the fence is required, the replacement fence will comply with Municipal Code Chapter 447, or its successor by-law.
